versions.description: Private Messages — players talk one-to-one without spamming global chat. msg <player> <text> sends a private message to an online player, r <text> replies to whoever messaged you last. mail <player> <text> leaves a message for a player who is offline; it is shown when they next join (mailbox to read again, mailclear to empty it). seen <player> shows when someone was last online. ignore <player> blocks someone's messages and mail (ignore alone lists them, unignore to undo). A shared cooldown stops spam. Optional staff social spy (off by default): staff with PM_SPY can turn on socialspy to get copies of private messages — tell your players if you enable it. Note: the command line itself goes through game chat; use a command prefix your game hides from public chat if privacy matters.

commands.name: msg
commands.helpText: Usage: msg <player> <text> — sends a private message to an online player.

arguments.name: message
arguments.helpText: Your message (the rest of the line)

commands.name: r
commands.description: Reply to your last private message
commands.helpText: Usage: r <text> — replies to the last player who messaged you.

arguments.name: message
arguments.helpText: Your reply (the rest of the line)

commands.name: mail
commands.helpText: Usage: mail <player> <text> — stores a message; the player gets it when they next join (or now, if online).

arguments.name: message
arguments.helpText: Your message (the rest of the line)

commands.name: mailbox
commands.helpText: Usage: mailbox — shows the mail in your mailbox.

commands.name: mailclear
commands.helpText: Usage: mailclear — deletes all mail in your mailbox.

commands.name: seen
commands.description: When was a player last online
commands.helpText: Usage: seen <player> — shows when a player was last seen on this server.

commands.name: ignore
commands.helpText: Usage: ignore <player> — blocks their private messages and mail. Without a name (or with "list") it shows who you ignore.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: Player name. Leave empty (or type list) to see your ignore list.

commands.name: unignore
commands.helpText: Usage: unignore <player|all> — allows their messages again.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: Player name from your ignore list, or all

commands.name: socialspy
commands.helpText: Usage: socialspy — turns copies of private messages on or off. Needs PM_SPY and the socialSpy setting.

hooks.name: deliver-mail
hooks.description: Shows new mail to a player when they join

functions.name: pm-helpers

permissions.description: Allows staff to turn on socialspy and see copies of private messages and mail (only when the socialSpy setting is on)
Messages and mail from this player reach others even if they ignore them (for staff)
